recentEvents.text: EVENT × DIPLOMATIC Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina Republika Srpska Un Resolution 816 — No Fly Zone Enforcement The UN Security Council passes Resolution 816, authorizing member states to enforce the no-fly zone over Bosnia-Herzegovina that had been violated over 500 times since its establishment in October 1992. On April 12 NATO commences Operation Deny Flight with combat air patrols, marking a shift from passive monitoring to active military involvement. INTELLIGENCE ASSESSMENT VRS patron pressure +5 ARBiH morale +2 VRS patron pressure +3 NATO combat aircraft now patrol Bosnian airspace. The VRS loses its fixed-wing air support but retains overwhelming ground-based fire superiority. ACKNOWLEDGED PRESIDENT'S DESK COMMAND SURFACE DIPLOMACY INTELLIGENCE ARMY HQ CHRONICLE FACTION WAR MAP ADVANCE WAR REQUIRED 0 STAFF REVIEW 4 29 Mar 1993

recentEvents.text: DECISION REQUIRED Herzeg-Bosna · 22 Feb 1993 Zagreb Restrains Boban: Hold Back During VOPP Window PRESIDENTIAL RESPONSE Acknowledge the message HISTORICAL DEFAULT This is the historically attested choice. You are free to choose any option. Herzeg-Bosna Patron Confidence +8 Herzeg-Bosna Negotiating Leverage -5 Herzeg-Bosna Internal Cohesion -3 Maintain our position Herzeg-Bosna Patron Confidence -10 Herzeg-Bosna Negotiating Leverage +6 Herzeg-Bosna Military Credibility +3 SITUATION Tuđman quietly orders Boban to restrain HVO offensive operations. The Vance-Owen provincial map is favorable to Croat Herzegovina — Zagreb needs HRHB to accept the plan, not derail it through military escalation. Boban signed the plan in Geneva on 2 January 1993 on Tudjman's direction, making HZ HB the first party to accept the ten-province framework. DOSSIER CATEGORY Diplomatic FACTION / DATE Herzeg-Bosna / 22 Feb 1993 DECISION CONTEXT Source dossier: The row represents Zagreb's restraint order on HVO offensive operations during the Vance-Owen acceptance window and the HZ HB Presidency's posture toward patron direction. Acknowledge-pressure is the ... Record trail: after your response, this decision is filed in the Chronicle decision ledger; Army HQ Records keeps consequences, opportunities, operations, and turn aftermath.
